briefHtml:
NAV and the tape

  • NAV S$10,236,161 · reported +0.14% · real day move ≈ -0.08% (S$-8,557 vs Wednesday's restated 10,244,718). NAV level authoritative.
  • Biggest mover in the book: SMIC +3.73% to HK$49.00 - second breakout day, one session BEFORE Q3 tonight. On the tape: CoreWeave +24%; NVDA +2.9% rebound (still ~-12% in November).
  • The one thing: the market looked through the hot CPI - SPX +1.31%, Nasdaq +1.60% (post-election losses erased), VIX -10.1% to 17.49 - with a December hike locked and a ~9.5% tail on 50bp. Bonds were shut (Veterans Day): 10y frozen at 4.983%; today's reopen + PPI Friday decide whether the 5.20% gate gets tested this week.
  • Asia Wed: STI +0.59% to 5,289.66 (day two of the rebound); HSI -0.98% to 24,316. Tencent 409.60 -1.96%, Xiaomi 30.10 -1.63%; Alibaba -0.98%, Meituan -3.51%.
  • Oil: Brent ~$91.69, +0.2% - stabilising just above $90. Metals choppy: silver ~$52.0 (+~0.9%), gold ~$4,030 fading toward ~$3,981 late; ratio ~78.
  • Tonight: SMIC Q3 after the HK close; AMAT (consensus ~$10.30bn / EPS $4.06) and CSCO after the US close; PPI Friday; NVDA 17 Nov, Tencent 18 Nov.

Flag integrity

  • riskFlags: ZERO - fifth consecutive clean snapshot.
  • L46.SI (Lum Chang): Yahoo 404, 31st consecutive session.
  • listedChgPct +0.82% - closest to a clean one-day read this week (Wed Asia + Wed US).
  • Nov 11 NAV restated UP to 10,244,718 (from 10,233,521); reported +0.14% vs real ≈ -0.08%.

Insider trades (last 7 days)

  • SGX direct check failed again - links.sgx.com API 404 for a second day; sweep via web sources only.
  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): nothing newer than the 4 Nov Form 1 - cadence pause now four trading sessions (5, 6, 10, 11 Nov).
  • DBS, OCBC, UOB, Fraser and Neave, VICOM, Straits Trading, CDL, UOL, Yanlord, Ho Bee, Seatrium, YZJ, Singtel, Keppel REIT: none found. HK names (Tencent, SMIC, Xiaomi): none found. US ETFs: none by construction.

Congress filings (via Unusual Whales)

  • No new filings since yesterday's brief - newest in the feed remain the 9 Nov batch (NY-3 Democrat's two US T-bill buys of $15k-50k each; TN-8 Republican's WBD sell; AK Republican's WDC sell). Nothing filed 10-11 Nov yet.

Trump / policy watch (24-48h)

  • Truce roll-over week: reciprocal-tariff suspension and 178 Section 301 exclusions hit their 10 Nov expiry; USTR extended the ships-301 action two months on 6 Nov; no snapback, no renewal notice yet. USTR
  • December hike locked, 50bp tail intact: no walk-back from Waller/Logan; FedWatch ~90.5% 25bp / ~9.5% 50bp. BLS CPI
  • Graham Act waiver digested: Russia duties incl. uranium stay waived - fuel-price priority; mildly positive for uranium/grid supply. Legal 500
  • NVDA probe day three: +2.9% rebound, chips led; Anthropic now seeking ~$1.4tn; CoreWeave +24%. Yahoo Finance
  • VIX 17.49, -10.1%: lowest since the crash; bonds reopen today with the 10y frozen at 4.983%. CBOE
  • Event cluster: SMIC Q3 tonight, AMAT/CSCO tonight, PPI Friday, NVDA 17 Nov, Tencent 18 Nov. Futunn

Risk

  • SMIC earnings TONIGHT: +6.4% two-day breakout into the print - some good news priced; GM guide 26-28% is the line.
  • Silver line ≈1.90x: collateral 1,777 oz × $52.0 × 1.2843 ≈ S$118,674 vs S$56,240 loan; equity ≈ S$62,434. Steady vs Wednesday's 1.91x.
  • Event cluster risk: four binary events across core themes inside six days (AMAT/CSCO, PPI, NVDA 17 Nov, Tencent 18 Nov).
  • Truce-expiry tail: failed renewals would snap tariffs back onto the HK/China sleeve (Tencent already -38% from its high).
  • FX: ~35% of net worth non-SGD; USDSGD 1.2843. Concentration: STI rebound only two sessions old into tonight's US data.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • TLT / Defense: deploy AT the 5.20% gate, not before - a hot PPI Friday could deliver the level. ~62% of the liquid book still idle cash.
  • SMIC 0981.HK: no chasing into tonight's print - staged entry only if the GM guide holds AND price holds above ~46 afterward; a zone re-entry is the cheaper entry.
  • Tencent 0700.HK: Asia-barbell deployment watch into 18 Nov at ~14x TTM - a clean Q3 with stable AI-capex commentary is the trigger to start building.

trumpWatch.title: US-China truce roll-over week: ships-301 extended, tariffs hit expiry
trumpWatch.detail: The reciprocal-tariff suspension and 178 Section 301 exclusions hit their 10 Nov 2026 expiry this week. USTR posted a two-month further suspension of the China maritime/logistics/shipbuilding Section 301 action on 6 Nov. No tariff snapback announced, no renewal notice sighted yet - direct read-through to China/HK tech and shipping names.

trumpWatch.title: December hike locked, 50bp tail intact - market looked through it
trumpWatch.detail: No walk-back from Waller/Logan after Tuesday's hot core CPI (0.3% met Waller's 50bp test). FedWatch: ~90.5% 25bp, ~9.5% 50bp for 8-9 Dec. Wednesday: SPX +1.31%, Nasdaq +1.60% erasing post-election losses.

trumpWatch.title: Graham Act waiver digested: Russia duties incl. uranium stay waived
trumpWatch.detail: Legal 500 analysis (11 Nov) of the October EO: the 500% Russia duty and secondary tariffs remain waived, including provisions touching Russian uranium - fuel-price and supply priorities over sanctions pressure. Marginally positive for uranium/grid supply chains.

trumpWatch.title: NVDA probe day three: stock rebounded +2.9%, chips led
trumpWatch.detail: NVDA +2.87% to ~$173.7 (still ~-12% in November); CoreWeave +24% on a strong revenue outlook; Anthropic's updated filing seeks ~$1.4tn. AI-compute demand prints still landing.

trumpWatch.title: Vol reset complete: VIX 17.49, -10.1%
trumpWatch.detail: From 28.18 a week ago to the lowest since the crash. Bond market was closed for Veterans Day - 10y frozen at 4.983%; reopen today plus jobless claims, then PPI Friday, test the 5% line. Duration gate 5.20% sits ~22bp above.

trumpWatch.title: Event cluster: SMIC Q3 tonight, AMAT/CSCO tonight, PPI Friday
trumpWatch.detail: SMIC Q3 after the HK close today (guide GM 26-28%, consensus rev $3.094bn +29.9% y/y; call Fri 8:30am SGT); AMAT (consensus ~$10.30bn, EPS $4.06) and CSCO after the US close; PPI Friday; NVDA earnings 17 Nov, Tencent 18 Nov.

opportunities.thesis: Defense/long-duration sleeve: 10y frozen at 4.983% through the Veterans Day bond closure, ~22bp below the 5.20% gate, with PPI Friday and a ~9.5% 50bp December tail.
opportunities.signal: Unchanged: tranche prepared, deploy AT the gate (5.20%), not before - a hot PPI Friday could deliver the level. ~62% of the liquid book still idle cash.
